name: Canaga Earthcaller
summary: Canaga Earthcaller is a Darkspear troll shaman stationed in the sunbaked Valley of Trials. He instructs novice Horde shamans in communing with the spirits of the land and obtaining their first elemental totems.

sections.title: Voice of the Land
sections.body: Perched on the red bluffs of the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller serves as one of the very first spiritual guides for Darkspear trolls and orcs who walk the path of the shaman. While many trainers focus strictly on martial readiness, Canaga teaches newcomers how to quiet their minds and listen to the rumblings of Kalimdor itself, preparing the earth sapta necessary to commune with the spirits.

sections.title: The First Totem
sections.body: Before any fledgling shaman can truly channel the elemental fury of the earth, they must prove their respect and resolve to the spirits. Canaga directs initiates to gather sacred reagents and journey to the local spirit rock in Durotar. Through his guidance, novices drink the earth sapta, behold the elemental spirits firsthand, and earn their Earth Totem.

faq.answer: Canaga Earthcaller is a Darkspear troll shaman residing in the Valley of Trials. He mentors young shamans taking their first steps in the Horde.

faq.q: What does Canaga teach young shamans?
faq.answer: Canaga oversees the Call of Earth ritual chain for Horde shamans starting in Durotar. He brews the Earth Sapta, a mystical draught that allows initiates to perceive and speak with the local earth elemental spirit to earn their first totem.

faq.q: What is the Earth Sapta Canaga prepares?
faq.answer: Earth Sapta is a specially brewed spiritual draught crafted from regional reagents. Shamans drink it to open their senses to the hidden spirits of the land, allowing them to communicate directly with elemental manifestations.

faq.q: Why is a troll training shamans in an orcish proving ground?
aliases: why troll in valley of trials
faq.answer: Following the Third War, the Darkspear tribe integrated closely with Thrall's Horde and settled alongside the orcs in Durotar. Troll shamans and warriors now train side by side with young orcs within the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Where can Canaga Earthcaller be found?
faq.answer: Canaga sits on the rock plateaus overlooking the eastern paths of the Valley of Trials, just south of the main training hub.

angles.text: Canaga is your very first spiritual mentor in Durotar, preparing the Earth Sapta so you can commune with the elements and claim your Earth Totem.
As one of the prominent Darkspear figures in the Valley of Trials, Canaga makes sure young troll shamans begin their path with the spirits properly guided.
Canaga works side by side with orcish instructors in the valley, helping young orcs bind their spirit to the harsh soil of their new homeland.
